questions.question: Who appoints the Chief Justice of India?
questions.explanation: The President appoints the Chief Justice of India.

questions.question: Who composed the song "Vande Mataram"?
questions.explanation: Bankim Chandra Chatterjee wrote "Vande Mataram".

questions.question: The Rajya Sabha has a maximum strength of:
questions.explanation: The maximum strength of the Rajya Sabha is 250 members.

questions.question: The Jallianwala Bagh massacre took place in which city?
questions.explanation: It occurred at Amritsar on 13 April 1919.

questions.question: Which tax was subsumed under GST?
questions.explanation: Service Tax (among others) was subsumed under GST.

questions.question: The President of India is elected by:
questions.explanation: The President is elected by an electoral college of MPs and MLAs.

questions.question: NITI Aayog replaced which earlier body?
questions.explanation: NITI Aayog replaced the Planning Commission in 2015.

questions.question: In which year was the Reserve Bank of India established?
questions.explanation: The RBI was established in 1935.

questions.question: The "Gateway of India" is located in which city?
questions.explanation: The Gateway of India is in Mumbai.

questions.question: Emperor Ashoka belonged to which dynasty?
questions.explanation: Ashoka was a Mauryan emperor.

questions.question: Which is the largest gland in the human body?
questions.explanation: The liver is the largest gland in the human body.

questions.question: The headquarters of the United Nations is in:
questions.explanation: The UN headquarters is in New York City.

questions.question: Which part of the Constitution deals with Fundamental Duties?
questions.explanation: Fundamental Duties are in Part IVA (Article 51A), added by the 42nd Amendment.

questions.question: The Simon Commission came to India in:
questions.explanation: The Simon Commission arrived in 1928 and was widely boycotted.

questions.question: The term "GDP" stands for:
questions.explanation: GDP = Gross Domestic Product.

questions.question: The author of the Indian national anthem is:
questions.explanation: Rabindranath Tagore wrote "Jana Gana Mana".

questions.question: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
questions.explanation: Mercury is the planet closest to the Sun.

questions.question: NABARD is associated primarily with:
questions.explanation: NABARD funds agriculture and rural development.

questions.question: Which gas is most abundant in the Earth’s atmosphere?
questions.explanation: Nitrogen is about 78% of the atmosphere.

questions.question: The deficiency of which vitamin causes scurvy?
questions.explanation: Scurvy is caused by a deficiency of Vitamin C.

questions.question: The Tropic of Cancer does NOT pass through which Indian state?
questions.explanation: It passes through 8 states but not Odisha.

questions.question: GST was implemented in India on:
questions.explanation: GST came into effect on 1 July 2017.

questions.question: Mount Everest is located in which country?
questions.explanation: Mount Everest lies on the Nepal–China border, with its peak in Nepal.

questions.question: Which is the highest civilian award in India?
questions.explanation: The Bharat Ratna is the highest civilian award.

questions.question: Which planet is known as the "Red Planet"?
questions.explanation: Mars looks red due to iron oxide on its surface.

questions.question: Which is the southernmost point of mainland India?
questions.explanation: Kanyakumari is the southernmost point of mainland India (Indira Point is the southernmost of Indian territory).

questions.question: Who founded the Arya Samaj?
questions.explanation: Swami Dayananda Saraswati founded the Arya Samaj in 1875.

questions.question: The financial year in India runs from:
questions.explanation: India’s financial year is April to March.

questions.question: The national flower of India is the:
questions.explanation: The lotus is India’s national flower.

questions.question: The unit of electrical resistance is the:
questions.explanation: Electrical resistance is measured in ohms.

questions.question: Which day is celebrated as International Yoga Day?
questions.explanation: International Yoga Day is 21 June.

questions.question: The minimum age to become the President of India is:
questions.explanation: A presidential candidate must be at least 35 years old.

questions.question: The "Sun Temple" at Konark is located in which state?
questions.explanation: The Konark Sun Temple is in Odisha.

questions.question: Which strait separates India from Sri Lanka?
questions.explanation: The Palk Strait separates India and Sri Lanka.

questions.question: The currency of the United Kingdom is the:
questions.explanation: The UK uses the Pound Sterling.

questions.question: The Non-Cooperation Movement was launched by Gandhi in:
questions.explanation: The Non-Cooperation Movement began in 1920.

questions.question: Which acid is present in the human stomach?
questions.explanation: The stomach uses hydrochloric acid for digestion.

questions.question: Which planet has the most moons in the solar system?
questions.explanation: Saturn currently has the most confirmed moons in the solar system.

questions.question: Which is the highest mountain peak entirely within India?
questions.explanation: Nanda Devi is the highest peak entirely within India.

questions.question: World Water Day is observed on:
questions.explanation: World Water Day is observed on 22 March.

questions.question: Which international body is headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland?
questions.explanation: The WHO is headquartered in Geneva.

questions.question: The national bird of India is the:
questions.explanation: The Indian peacock is the national bird.

questions.question: In which sport is the term "googly" used?
questions.explanation: A "googly" is a type of delivery in cricket.

questions.question: How many fundamental rights are currently guaranteed by the Indian Constitution?
questions.explanation: There are 6 fundamental rights after the Right to Property was removed in 1978.

questions.question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution guarantees the Right to Constitutional Remedies?
questions.explanation: Article 32 is called the "heart and soul" of the Constitution.

questions.question: Which part of the plant conducts photosynthesis using the green pigment?
questions.explanation: Chlorophyll is the green pigment that captures light energy.

questions.question: The "fiscal deficit" is the difference between:

options.A: Total expenditure and total receipts excluding borrowings

questions.explanation: Fiscal deficit = total expenditure − total receipts (excluding borrowings).

questions.question: Which is the smallest state in India by area?
questions.explanation: Goa is the smallest Indian state by area.

questions.question: Who is the supreme commander of the Indian Armed Forces?
questions.explanation: The President is the supreme commander of the armed forces.

questions.question: What is 20% of 160?

Find the compound interest on ₹5000 at 10% per annum for 2 years.

An article costing ₹540 is sold at a 25% profit. Find the selling price.
Find the average of the first five multiples of 4.
questions.explanation: Multiples: 4, 8, 12, 16, 20. Sum = 60. Average = 60/5 = 12.

questions.question: Two numbers are in the ratio 2 : 5 and their sum is 42. Find the larger number.
questions.explanation: Total parts = 7. Each part = 42/7 = 6. Larger = 5 × 6 = 30.

questions.question: A train 150 m long crosses a pole in 9 seconds. Find its speed in km/h.
A can do a work in 12 days and B in 4 days. Working together, in how many days will they finish it?
questions.explanation: Combined one-day work = 1/12 + 1/4 = 16/48. Time = 48/16 = 3 days.

questions.question: Find the area of a circle with radius 21 cm. (Use π = 22/7)
Find the value of √144.
After a 10% discount, an item costs ₹540. Find its marked price.
Find 50% of 50% of 1700.
Two numbers are in the ratio 5 : 9 and their difference is 28. Find the smaller number.
questions.explanation: Difference = 4 parts = 28, so each part = 7. Smaller = 5 × 7 = 35.

questions.question: A boat travels 68 km downstream in 4 hours. If the speed of the stream is 3 km/h, find the speed of the boat in still water.
questions.explanation: Downstream speed = 68/4 = 17 km/h = boat + stream. Boat = 17 − 3 = 14 km/h.

questions.question: Find the value of ∛2197.
A train 200 m long crosses a platform 100 m long in 15 seconds. Find its speed in km/h.
questions.explanation: Total distance = 200 + 100 = 300 m in 15 s = 20 m/s = 72 km/h.

questions.question: What is 50% of 80?
Find the simple interest on ₹2100 at 8% per annum for 5 years.
Find the compound interest on ₹4000 at 10% per annum for 2 years.
An article costing ₹600 is sold for ₹660. Find the profit percentage.
An article costing ₹300 is sold at a 10% profit. Find the selling price.

Two numbers are in the ratio 5 : 7 and their sum is 48. Find the larger number.
questions.explanation: Total parts = 12. Each part = 48/12 = 4. Larger = 7 × 4 = 28.

questions.question: A train 200 m long crosses a pole in 10 seconds. Find its speed in km/h.
If today is Wednesday, what day will it be after 45 days?
questions.explanation: 45 mod 7 = 3; Wednesday + 3 = Saturday.

questions.question: Which letter is 2nd to the right of the 7th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 7th letter = G; 7 + 2 = 9th letter = I.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (5, 125), (6, 220), (2, 8), (4, 64)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 6³ = 216, not 220.

questions.question: In a row of 40 students, Ravi is 24th from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 40 − 24 + 1 = 17.

questions.question: Find the next term: 49, 64, 81, 100, 121, ?
questions.explanation: These are perfect squares 7²…11². Next is 12² = 144.

questions.question: Find the next term: 3, 5, 9, 15, 23, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 2 each step; next difference is 10, so 23 + 10 = 33.

questions.question: If FISH is coded as HKUJ, how is LAMP coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 2. Applying the same to LAMP gives NCOR.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 3:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 3:00 the angle is 3 × 30° = 90°.
The relation is squaring: 10² = 100, so 12² = 144.

questions.question: A person walks 5 km East and then 12 km North. What is the shortest distance from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Shortest distance = √(5² + 12²) = √169 = 13 km.

questions.question: If + means ×, and × means −, then evaluate: 6 + 4 × 6.
questions.explanation: Replace symbols: 6 × 4 − 6 = 24 − 6 = 18.

questions.question: Find the next term: 4, 12, 36, 108, ?
questions.explanation: Each term follows ×3: 108 × 3 = 324.

questions.question: Complete the series: E, I, M, Q, ?
questions.explanation: Each letter advances by 4 places, so the next is U.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: 2, 9, 3, 17
questions.explanation: 3, 2, 17 are prime numbers; 9 is a composite number.

questions.question: Which letter is 5th from the right end of the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: The 5th letter from the right is the 22nd from the left = V.
The relation is cubing: 4³ = 64, so 3³ = 27.

questions.question: If today is Sunday, what day will it be after 10 days?
questions.explanation: 10 mod 7 = 3; Sunday + 3 = Wednesday.

questions.question: Which letter is 5th to the right of the 3rd letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 3rd letter = C; 3 + 5 = 8th letter = H.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (8, 512), (4, 62), (2, 8), (5, 125)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 4³ = 64, not 62.

questions.question: In a row of 51 students, Ravi is 39th from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 51 − 39 + 1 = 13.

questions.question: Find the next term: 9, 16, 25, 36, 49, ?
questions.explanation: These are perfect squares 3²…7². Next is 8² = 64.

questions.question: Find the next term: 3, 7, 13, 21, 31, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 2 each step; next difference is 12, so 31 + 12 = 43.

questions.question: If RAIN is coded as UDLQ, how is LAMP coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 3. Applying the same to LAMP gives ODPS.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 1:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 1:00 the angle is 1 × 30° = 30°.
The relation is squaring: 8² = 64, so 11² = 121.
